page.overview:
What is Carkol?

Carkol is shaped like a mine cart made of coal. It has a round head that has teeth made out of red-hot coal. Its four legs resemble the wheels of the mine cart and functions like them. It carries a pile of burning coal on its back.

The coal formed from Carkol's body once helped fuel the lives of people living in Galar. They are thrill-seeking Pokémon that enjoy traveling at high speeds.

Carkoal can travel over 18 mph by rolling all four of its legs very fast. They can also breath fire that can reach 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Due to their internal coal tars, their heaps of coal never fall apart even when they race at high speeds.

Carkoal evolves from Rolycoly starting at level 18 and evolves into Coalossal starting at level 34.
